Do you enjoy diagnosing system bottlenecks using command line network tools?
Is configuring routers, switches, and secure access lists appealing to you?
Are you more passionate about infrastructure connectivity than writing application software?

careerDetails.futureScopeDetail: The WEF Top Emerging Technologies report flags Integrated Sensing and Communication as a game-changer for 6G and next-generation connectivity. Combined with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and Low-Earth-Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations, networking engineers are rebuilding global connectivity infrastructure.
